# A constant limit, for i := 0; i < 16; i++, is rewritten with the limit spelled out.
# Slices shorter than the limit panic, even when their capacity is larger.

exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want

env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func Saxpy16(a float32, x, y []float32) {
	for i := 0; i < 16; i++ {
		y[i] += a * x[i]
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import (
	"simd"
	"unsafe"
)

func Saxpy16(a float32, x, y []float32) {
	_vcAFloat32s0 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(a)
	if _loopvecOverlap(y, x, 0, 16, 0, 16) {
		for i := 0; i < 16; i++ {
			y[i] += a * x[i]
		}
	} else {
		_ = y[16-1]
		_ = x[16-1]
		{
			_w1 := y[:16:16]
			_count := len(_w1)
			_w2 := x[:_count:_count]
			_i, _lanes := 0, simd.BroadcastFloat32s(0).Len()
			for ; _i <= _count-4*_lanes; _i += 4 * _lanes {
				_c1, _c2 := _w1[_i:][:4*_lanes], _w2[_i:][:4*_lanes]
				_v1 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2)
				_v2 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c1)
				_v1.MulAdd(_vcAFloat32s0, _v2).Store(_c1)
				_v3 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2[_lanes:])
				_v4 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c1[_lanes:])
				_v3.MulAdd(_vcAFloat32s0, _v4).Store(_c1[_lanes:])
				_v5 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2[2*_lanes:])
				_v6 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c1[2*_lanes:])
				_v5.MulAdd(_vcAFloat32s0, _v6).Store(_c1[2*_lanes:])
				_v7 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c2[3*_lanes:])
				_v8 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_c1[3*_lanes:])
				_v7.MulAdd(_vcAFloat32s0, _v8).Store(_c1[3*_lanes:])
			}
			for ; _i <= _count-_lanes; _i += _lanes {
				_v9 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_w2[_i:])
				_v10 := simd.LoadFloat32s(_w1[_i:])
				_v9.MulAdd(_vcAFloat32s0, _v10).Store(_w1[_i:])
			}
			for _i < _count {
				_v11, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(_w2[_i:])
				_v12, _ := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(_w1[_i:])
				_v11.MulAdd(_vcAFloat32s0, _v12).StorePart(_w1[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func _loopvecOverlap[T any](a, b []T, aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi int) bool {
	if aLo >= aHi || bLo >= bHi {
		return false
	}
	size := unsafe.Sizeof(a[0])
	aBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	bBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	return aBase+uintptr(aLo)*size < bBase+uintptr(bHi)*size && bBase+uintptr(bLo)*size < aBase+uintptr(aHi)*size
}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func try(f func()) (panicked bool) {
	defer func() { panicked = recover() != nil }()
	f()
	return
}

func ramp(n int, scale float32) []float32 {
	s := make([]float32, n)
	for i := range s {
		s[i] = float32(i+1) * scale
	}
	return s
}

func main() {
	x, y := ramp(20, 1), ramp(20, 10)
	test.Saxpy16(2, x, y)
	fmt.Println(y)
	long := make([]float32, 3, 40)
	fmt.Println(try(func() { test.Saxpy16(2, x, long) }), try(func() { test.Saxpy16(2, x[:15], y) }))
}
-- testmain/output --
[12 24 36 48 60 72 84 96 108 120 132 144 156 168 180 192 170 180 190 200]
true true
